block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Standalone Engine Configuration Master Manifest orchestrating runtime, io, diagnostics, viewport, and audio.
what_it_enables: Zero dynamic heap allocations across Layer 0 data profiles
Deterministic bounded mathematics, saturation, and safe division
Monotonic frame pacing for 60 FPS and 120 FPS high-refresh displays
Categorized static ring buffer telemetry and diagnostic logs
64-snapshot time-travel simulation rewind and FNV-1a state hashing
Direct asset path acceleration with graceful procedural fallback
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across Layer 0 execution (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Dynamic data path resolution across workspace candidates
Direct asset paths are optional: missing paths default to dynamic VFS search or procedural floor

pre_conditions.memory_model: Static fixed buffers without heap allocation
